<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (tenets 1-6). Binding architecture: flowspace3 crate-enforced hexagonal, functional core (fs3-architecture.md in the rust-port-handover packet) applied to pij, LAYOUT INCLUDED — Jordan likes fs3's file organization, so we mirror it: crates/ at repo root (one crate per responsibility), Cargo workspace at root, docs/rules-idioms-architecture/ for the promoted architecture doc. Boundaries are crates gated by a committed dependency allowlist with per-row rationale (negative-tested); core has no tokio/no IO; ports are minimal object-safe traits; adapters own wire quirks; daemon+cli are the only composition roots, in ONE binary; testkit ships fakes for every port, fake-as-default config, offline-first. Tier rule: pure logic->core, tmux IO->tmux, harness quirks->harnesses, persistence->store, wiring->daemon/cli. Queue-first daemon: a handler does one cheap statement, everything else is a job (enqueue+dedupe+serialized claims). INTERFACES SETTLED 2026-08-28 by workshop 001 (assets/workshops/001-architecture.md): SQLite/sqlx store (R1), crate graph ratified by Jordan (R2), six ports frozen — a seventh is stop-and-ask (R3), queue-first semantics (R4), all 10 TS defects fix-in-port (R5), wave-0 additions a-f (R6). Changes are prime rulings recorded in the workshop file.
